sources.title: CJEU, joined cases C-37/20 and C-601/20, 22 November 2022 (beneficial-owner registers: general public access struck down as disproportionate privacy interference)
Tower Amendment, Exchange Act sec 15B(d), 15 U.S.C. 78o-4(d) (bars SEC/MSRB from forcing issuer filings; does not bar a local ethics rule)
Financial Data Transparency Act of 2022, Title LVIII, NDAA FY2023 (Pub. L. 117-263): machine-readable muni filings; adds no owner identity
SEC Rule 15c2-12 (2019 amendments): private bank loans placed on EMMA; still no owner names
MSRB EMMA — official statement and trade data for municipal securities
MSRB Rule G-17 — fair dealing; conflict disclosures in official statements
NFMA, Conflicts of Interest in the Municipal Securities Market (2015) — participant conflict map (advisory)
GFOA guidance addresses beneficial owners of defaulted municipal securities only
Tax Justice Network, Roadmap to Effective Beneficial Ownership Transparency (2023) — targets company shells, not municipal bondholders
Open Ownership, Principles for Effective Beneficial Ownership Disclosure (January 2023)
Dubrow & Hiteshew, ProMarket, 23 October 2024 — official-statement readability; not ownership
